rationale: The filing presents one explicit grand total on the balance sheet and repeats the same fair value in the final Total Investment Portfolio row of the schedule. The two affiliation subtotals are $2,197,284 thousand non-controlled/non-affiliated plus $8,288 thousand non-controlled/affiliated, which equals $2,205,572 thousand. There is no separately presented controlled schedule to add. Thus the companyfacts tag captured the complete investment portfolio, not merely a subtotal. The total is 94.01% of total assets and leaves $140,571 thousand of non-investment assets, a plausible balance-sheet remainder.
